name: prompt-optimizer
description: Compare invoice extraction or support-ticket triage with one fixed prompt on two models, locally or in AgentCore, and inspect quality, cost and latency.

interface.shortDescription: Compare extraction and triage quality, cost and latency
interface.longDescription: Compare two models on a fixed prompt, locally or on AgentCore. Start with invoice extraction or support-ticket triage, then explore interactive dashboards for quality, model cost, latency and individual trial evidence.
defaultPrompt: Show me the interactive results dashboard and explain what the saved evidence can support.
Help me prepare the support-ticket triage starter and challenge its expected answers.
Prepare a model comparison and help me choose local or AgentCore execution.
